d: Stellantis India MD and CEO Shailesh Hazela in an interview with Hormazd Sorabjee outlines the company’s India roadmap to 2030. Under the global Fast Lane 2030 plan, Jeep and Citroen will get seven new products and five refreshes, backed by an additional investment of around ₹4,000 crore in product, localisation and customer experience. The first launch is planned for Q2 2027. Hazela also discusses the mix of CBUs and local products under the India-EU FTA, exports of powertrains and vehicles, the multi-energy strategy (ICE, hybrid, EV and CNG), CAFE 3 compliance, Jeep’s 4x4 DNA, Citroen’s…
